scope: Independent desktop-only bounded pixel review of five existing offline headless English course screenshots

evidence.identityVerification: Local byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes checked against the desktop entries of the supplied display report; no additional visual image opens
evidence.imageViewing: Exactly one parallel batch of five view_image calls; no crops, reopens, source images, or mobile images

observations: The native opening viewport visibly reads 'The basic properties of ferromagnetic materials' and 'Printed page 318'. The English heading and opening prose are legible, consistently aligned, and contained within the centered reading column.

Despite its polarization filename, the viewport is the opening ferromagnetism section. It visibly includes the introductory coil/core discussion, remanence prose, and an inline mathematical mu without a missing-glyph box or collision.

The whole-page overview is nonblank and shows continuous prose, equations, section separators, all three figures, and the English captions 'Figure 301', 'Figure 302', and 'Figure 303'. No obvious overlap, clipping, or unwanted horizontal overflow is visible at the reviewed overview scale.

The whole-page view visibly places the retained source Curie numbers near an explicit historical-report disclaimer saying that some disagree with current reference values and must not be treated as reliable present-day Curie temperatures. This records visible disclaimer presence and association only, not a new assessment of the numbers.
The approved source-name parentheticals '(居里)' and '(斯托列托夫, 1839-1896)' are intentionally retained. Their presence is not a visual revision request or an English-only text claim.

The overview visibly renders I = B - B_0 and I = (mu - 1)B_0 with equation numbers (13-2) and (13-3), without an obvious display failure. I is retained as the source's magnetization notation, not interpreted as wire current.
The separate Figure 301 view has a visible curve, axes, arrowheads, and readable I, B_0, and 0 labels, with no apparent label clipping or unwanted overlap.

The separate Figure 302 view visibly renders its curves, direction markers, and labels I, B_0, o, a, a-prime, b, b-prime, c, and c-prime without an apparent missing label, clipping, or obstructive collision.

The separate Figure 303 view visibly renders both panels and the complete English headings '(a) Soft magnetic' and '(b) Hard magnetic'. The axes, curves, I, B_0, and 0 labels remain visible and separated from the panel headings and image edges.
Figures 301-303 are instructional media at the reported actual desktop width of 640 px. The 686 px screenshot widths include surrounding capture space and are not asserted to be media widths.
limitations: PASS is bounded to these five existing desktop PNGs from an isolated headless offline render. It is not a production, headed-browser, interactive, or complete-course acceptance claim.

The whole-page image was automatically downsampled from 1440x10211 to 846x6000 for viewing. It supports page-level continuity, placement, and obvious display-defect checks, but cannot certify every body glyph, equation detail, or caption at native resolution.

Native-detail inspection is limited to the 1440x960 opening ferromagnetism viewport and the three separate figure screenshots. Later body paragraphs, the historical disclaimer, name parentheticals, displayed equations, and captions were inspected only in the downsampled whole-page overview.
No mobile image was opened or judged, and no mobile approval is granted.

Existing independent bilingual SCI/ZHEN and original SVG geometry/source approvals are reused as stipulated. No new source-fidelity, scientific-data, translation, or geometry review was performed, and no source image was opened.
The current English body is exactly unchanged by this review. No asset, figure label, mathematical semantics, source number, or historical disclaimer was edited.

The intentionally retained Chinese name parentheticals and reported Chinese machine accessibility labels prevent any full English-only or complete English accessibility claim. Accessibility behavior was not inspected.
The 640 px instructional media widths are taken from the supplied report and width-binding evidence, not newly measured in a live browser.
